verdicts.reason: A: 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' is pushed up against the top edge, about 400px away from its headline, so the two no longer read as a group. The confetti is packed into the upper third, leaving a large dead band in the middle and empty space at the bottom. The owls have shrunk to tiny icons that compete with the headline instead of framing it. B has the same tiny owls, compressed confetti block and empty top and bottom bands. It still scores higher because the kicker, confetti and headline form one tighter vertical group, even though the kicker is still far from the title and the layout feels like a shrunk copy of the original.
